name: Tselane and the Singing Giant
shortDescription: Tselane learns to trust more than a familiar song when a clever giant copies her mother's voice and tries to trick her into opening the door.
longDescription: After her father's death, Tselane stays behind at the old family home while her mother moves to a new village. They create a special song so Tselane knows when it is safe to open the door. A giant secretly learns the song, changes his voice and deceives her, but Tselane's mother follows his trail, outsmarts him and rescues her daughter. In the adapted ending, Tselane discovers that moving to a new home does not mean leaving her father's memory behind.
